title: Each representative change writes one log entry with before and after
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its card shows one "Sales Representative" field reading "Unassigned".
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Change Sales Representative to {Sales-rep-A}.
  2. Open the work order's menu and click Audit Log.
  3. Close the log, click the + and add "Sales Representative - Parts", then set Parts to {Sales-rep-B}.
  4. Open the work order's menu and click Audit Log.
  5. Close the log, click the remove x beside Parts.
  6. Open the work order's menu and click Audit Log.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 2: the newest entry is "Sales representative changed" reading "Sales Representative: Unassigned → {Sales-rep-A}".
  • Step 3: Labor reads {Sales-rep-A} and Parts {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 4: two new entries: adding the field "Sales Representative: {Sales-rep-A} → {Sales-rep-A} (Parts) · {Sales-rep-A} (Labor)", then "{Sales-rep-A} (Parts) · {Sales-rep-A} (Labor) → {Sales-rep-B} (Parts) · {Sales-rep-A} (Labor)".
  • Step 5: one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 6: a new entry reads "Sales Representative: {Sales-rep-B} (Parts) · {Sales-rep-A} (Labor) → {Sales-rep-A}".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11271 (Story 7, Record representative changes in the work order log); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S7-R1, S7-R2, S7-R3, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Step 4: whether adding the Parts field with the same person on both sides writes an entry is a question for the product owner (S7-R1 says adding the field writes one; S7-R4 says a change that leaves the representatives as they were writes none). Until answered, judge the entry for setting Parts to {Sales-rep-B} and record what you see for the add.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R1: “Each change to a work order's representatives, including adding or removing the Parts field, writes one log entry, "Sales representative changed".”
  • S7-R2: “The entry shows "Sales Representative: {before} → {after}". A work order that is not split reads the one name, or "Unassigned".”
  • S7-R3: “A split work order reads both sides, Parts first: "Devon Whitfield (Parts) · Elliot Brennan (Labor)". An empty side reads "Unassigned", for example "Devon Whitfield (Parts) · Unassigned (Labor)".”

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 1, board 1.19 "The log records every rep change", export read 19 Oct 2026. The PRD's Story 7 says "Design: none", yet this board shows the log; its wording is checked in the "Design — how it looks" case for the log.
